title: STREAMLINED TECH JOB RECRUITMENT WEBSITE
summary: I built a responsive front-end of a tech job recruitment website with Vue.js and used Pinia for a simple role-based access system
name: SYNC POOL
description: A streamlined, front-end recruitment platform designed to connect job seekers and employers through a user-centric interface. By using Vue 3, This website was made for simple navigation in mind for users and features a refined client-side CRUD system for effortless management of job listings. For serverless deployment environments, a cloud mock API (Mockfly) is used to generate JSON data and simulate stateful RESTful responses

title: STORY-DRIVEN ADVENTURE GAME
summary: Participated in Gameseed 2026 game jam, I developed a prototype of side-scrolling adventure game by using Godot engine
name: THE DOCTOR IS DREAM
description: The Doctor is Dream game explores the doctor's personal nostalgic, imaginative, and life-changing background story as the core motivation to help people through the medical field. We integrated this narrative design into our core side-scrolling gameplay mechanics to fully immerse players in the story. This game prototype was developed in Godot engine and created all pixel art assets using Aseprite within a strict three-week game jam timeline

title: SPACE TACTICS RPG ISOMETRIC GAME (WIP)
summary: Currently in development of a indie game project made with Unity that features tile-based movement, turn-based combat, and RPG elements.
name: SPACYTICS
description: Spacytics is a turn-based/grid-based tactics RPG game where player has to fight through challenging enemies from outerspace. Along the playthrough, player will ecounter companions that can be recruited, player will also ecounter a shop to acquire some item that will help defeat the enemies. Every section has a progressively challenging boss that player have to defeat to progress through the level.

title: PERSONAL PORTFOLIO WEBSITE
summary: Complete rebuild of my personal portofolio website using React to transition from static web development to component-based architecture.
name: HISYAM PORTFOLIO
description: An interactive and responsive portfolio web application that serves as a practical environment to implement and stress-test various React front-end libraries, while leveraging Next.js to handle email-sending through serverless functions. This portfolio website focuses on effective UI/UX transitions and efficient data handling, ensuring the site is both highly interactive for users and easy to scale on the server.

title: CRUD API FOR A FULL-STACK WESBSITE
summary: A REST API project made with Node.js and MongoDB for an upcoming full-stack community-driven website
name: FULLSTACK PROJECT IDEAS API
description: Fullstack project ideas API is a dedicated RESTful API designed to serve as a collaborative hub for developers. It allows users to contribute, manage, and discover curated full-stack project ideas. This API was Implemented with Mongoose for Projects & Users model, CRUD endpoints for Project User register & login endpoints, and Auth middleware using JWT.

title: SOCIAL READING WEBSITE THAT CONNECTS READERS
summary: I developed a responsive website as a personal project to learn Laravel from scratch. This website feature post category system and social features like sharing and commenting
name: MINDRINGER
description: A minimalist and user-friendly website developed using Laravel and Tailwind frameworks, combining the integration of backend functionality and responsive frontend design. Mindringer offers a clean space for writers to share ideas and connect with readers

title: HAND-GESTURE-CONTROLLED FIGHTING GAME
summary: Developed as an undergraduate thesis project, this game utilizes the Pygame framework integrated with a MediaPipe machine learning model for hand gesture recognition
name: STREET TROUBLES
description: Street Troubles is a traditional 2D fighting game with a twist of hand gesture recognition feature that will make you able to play the game with your hand. The game consist of 3 gamemode, which is Classic Battle, Gesture Battle, and Hybrid Battle. When in battle, your objective is to fight your enemy (computer) with 3 attack move that you can use. The pixel art character animation and background sprite were created using Krita and the UI were designed using Figma.

title: TRADITIONAL-DIGITAL GAME FOR ENGLISH LEARNING
summary: A freelance game project made for Muhammadiyah University of Purwokerto, I developed a game with Godot engine that integrate english grammar quizzes and interactive game mechanic.
name: ENGKLEK HOP
description: An interactive 2D game adaptation of a traditional indonesian game (Engklek) made in the Godot engine with a hand drawn style design and user-friendly game interface. Engklek Hop was built as a learning environment where students can improve their english grammar proficiency by playing the game. In this game, player will able to play in singleplayer or (turn-based) multiplayer mode.

title: EXCITING TOP-DOWN 3D CLEANING GAME
summary: I participated in a game development project from the independent study program by Agate Academy, developed a game with Unity engine that features 3 maps with different objective and obstacle.
name: SUPER CLEANER
description: Super Cleaner is a low-poly top-down 3D game where the player must race against time as an extraordinary janitor cleaning up the chaos left behind by the superhero and monster battles. This game was developed during my initial transition into the Unity ecosystem. It served as a practical application of my learning, allowing me to learn C# scripting, node-based architecture, and game features development while building a functional game from the ground up.

title: TRAIN SCHEDULING SYSTEM FOR A TRAIN STATION
summary: Involved in a full-stack website development for an internship project. I was responsible for making the CRUD functionalities, designing user interface, and integrating back-end components.
name: SINJAKA
description: A user-friendly website for managing train schedule with admin CRUD functionalities and database integrated train schedule. This website is developed for Indonesian Railways Company specifically for DAOP 5 Purwokerto. The front-end of the website were built with HTML and CSS without using any framework, and the UI were designed using Figma. As for the back-end, MySQL was used to accomodate the database for the train schedule table.
